name: Jinja
summary: Text template language for Python with Python-like expressions, {% %} control tags, filters, macros and block-based template inheritance; templates are compiled to Python code. Used by Flask, Ansible, dbt, Salt and many static-site and configuration tools, and re-implemented in several other host languages.

level_notes.0: pallets/jinja (Python) is the reference implementation: lexer -> parser -> AST (nodes) -> optional optimizer -> Python source code generator -> runtime. Independent implementations of the same template language exist for Rust (MiniJinja), JavaScript (Nunjucks), Java (Jinjava), C++ (Jinja2Cpp) and Go (pongo2 follows the Django/Jinja syntax).
level_notes.1: There is no formal specification or grammar. The 'Template Designer Documentation' in the official docs is the de-facto language reference, the API and Extensions chapters document the embedding interface, and the reference implementation decides everything else.
level_notes.2: Much of the tutorial literature is written from the viewpoint of a host tool (Flask, Ansible, dbt, Salt, Home Assistant), each of which adds its own filters and globals.
level_notes.3: Encyclopedic coverage is thin; the Wikipedia article and the comparison table of web template engines are the main tertiary sources.

src/jinja2/lexer.py — regex-driven lexer, token types, delimiters and whitespace-control handling
src/jinja2/parser.py — recursive-descent parser for statements ({% if %}, {% for %}, {% macro %}, {% block %}...) and expressions
src/jinja2/nodes.py — AST node classes (For, If, Macro, Block, Extends, Include, Filter, Test, CondExpr...)
src/jinja2/compiler.py — CodeGenerator: compiles the AST to Python source (visit_For, visit_If, visit_Macro, visit_Block, visit_Include...)
src/jinja2/idtracking.py — symbol tables and frame analysis for name resolution in generated code
src/jinja2/optimizer.py — constant-folding optimizer over the AST
src/jinja2/visitor.py — NodeVisitor / NodeTransformer base classes for AST passes
src/jinja2/runtime.py — runtime: Context, LoopContext (the 'loop' variable), Macro, BlockReference (super()), Undefined types
src/jinja2/environment.py — Environment and Template: configuration, compilation pipeline, rendering entry points
src/jinja2/filters.py — built-in filters (default, join, map, groupby, sort, tojson, escape...)
src/jinja2/tests.py — built-in tests (defined, none, iterable, divisibleby, sameas...)

src/jinja2/ext.py — extension API and bundled extensions (i18n/gettext, do, loopcontrols, debug)
src/jinja2/bccache.py — bytecode caches for compiled templates (file system, memcached)
src/jinja2/nativetypes.py — NativeEnvironment: render to native Python values instead of strings
